32.old: Townhomes are strata-titled under the BC Strata Property Act. Request Form B, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the bylaws (rentals, pets and age restrictions) before removing subjects; 55+ and 45+ complexes enforce age bylaws that apply to at least one occupant.
32.new: A Chilliwack townhome is strata-titled, so the BC Strata Property Act applies. Before you remove subjects, collect Form B, the depreciation report, two years of strata minutes and the bylaws, paying attention to the rules on rentals, pets and age restrictions. In 55+ and 45+ complexes, the age bylaws bind at least one occupant.

34.old: Floodplain: parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow and lower Sardis lie in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, protected by the City's dike network. Ask for the property's flood construction level, lender and insurer requirements, and whether a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered on title.
34.new: Floodplain: portions of Rosedale, Greendale, Yarrow, Fairfield Island and lower Sardis sit within the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, which the City's dike network protects. Get the property's flood construction level, then check lender and insurer requirements, and confirm if title carries a geotechnical or floodplain covenant.

36.old: Schools and transit: Chilliwack is served by School District 33 (SD33) — Sardis Secondary, G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and a range of elementary catchments including Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Always confirm catchment with SD33 before buying. BC Transit runs Chilliwack routes along Vedder Road, Luckakuck Way and Young Road, and the Fraser Valley Express (Route 66) links Chilliwack to Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.
36.new: Schools and transit: SD33 (School District 33) is the district for Chilliwack. Elementary catchments include Watson, Unsworth and Vedder, and the secondary options include G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and Sardis Secondary. Verify the catchment with SD33 before you buy. BC Transit routes in Chilliwack use Luckakuck Way, Vedder Road and Young Road, and Route 66 (Fraser Valley Express) runs from Chilliwack to Abbotsford and on to Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

Age rules in 55+ and 45+ complexes are enforced on at least one occupant.

51.new: In Chilliwack, schools fall under School District 33 (SD33). North-side homes feed Chilliwack Secondary, while homes in Sardis and on the south side feed Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham. Catchment boundaries change over time, so verify with SD33 for a specific address.

53.new: Yes. Chilliwack has local BC Transit routes on Young Road, Vedder Road and Luckakuck Way, along with the Fraser Valley Express to Abbotsford and Langley. Ryder Lake, Greendale and Columbia Valley, being rural, get little or no bus service.
